evidence.acquisition_action: Extract legal identity and reporting basis from audited statements; verify the listing against the exchange or SEC.
Read the operating-segment note and issuer annual report for products, geography, subsidiaries and business economics.
Extract board, committees, remuneration and related parties from the board report; monitor official appointment disclosures.

categories.description: Major holders, free float and ownership changes.

evidence.acquisition_action: Capture major holders, foreign ownership and free float from the official exchange company profile and version every observation.
Backfill audited annual statements and interim periods, preserving restatements, quarter/YTD/TTM semantics and page provenance.

categories.description: Audit opinion, one-offs, restatements and cash conversion.

evidence.acquisition_action: Extract audit opinion, key audit matters, going-concern language, one-offs and impairments; calculate cash conversion.
Calculate the applicable corporate, bank, insurer or loss-making-company ratio pack from primary facts with declared formulas.
Extract sector-specific operating KPIs from annual reports, presentations and data supplements with units and dimensions.
Backfill official dividend and corporate-action disclosures, then calculate payout, yield and continuity metrics.
Ingest official regulator/statistics series and retain issuer management commentary as supporting context only.

categories.description: Peers, market share and relative position.

evidence.acquisition_action: Build peer sets from reviewed classifications and calculate period-safe comparisons from the engine's own sourced facts.
Archive official daily prices, volume and turnover; calculate 52-week ranges, returns, volatility and beta internally.
Extract issuer guidance from official presentations/disclosures and keep external estimates explicitly attributed.
Ingest only licensed or publicly attributable recommendations, targets and consensus with provider and as-of date.

categories.description: Relative and intrinsic valuation with declared methodology.

evidence.acquisition_action: Calculate relative valuation from current market data and TTM/FY facts; publish intrinsic values only with explicit assumptions.

categories.description: Disclosed risks, debt, concentration and contingencies.

evidence.acquisition_action: Extract disclosed risk factors, debt maturities, concentration, contingencies and rating opinions with source attribution.
Extract issuer-reported environmental and social KPIs; keep third-party ESG ratings attributed and rights-controlled.

categories.description: Official announcements, attributed press and IR materials.

evidence.acquisition_action: Continuously archive official disclosures and IR materials; attach named press coverage as secondary context.
